Name: Inception Mercury
Summary: Direct Mercury API with a one-time new-account trial and optional paid usage.

SetupSteps.Title: Open your account
SetupSteps.Description: Create or sign in to your own Inception account if desired. No registration is performed by lain.

SetupSteps.Title: Create an API key
SetupSteps.Description: Use API Keys; no payment details are required for the documented new-account trial.

SetupSteps.Title: Check the account
SetupSteps.Description: Confirm actual trial balance and any expiry in Billing. Connection remains untested until credentials are supplied.

BillingPlans.Name: New-account trial
BillingPlans.ResetDescription: One-time grant; no recurring reset. Expiry is not stated.
BillingPlans.Notes: Official offer: 100 million initial tokens. Eligibility, actual grant, remaining balance and expiry are not observed. No payment details required.

BillingPlans.Name: Paid API usage
BillingPlans.Notes: Requires separately configured billing; promotional prices are not fixed in lain.

Routes.Name: Mercury 3
Routes.FreeOnlyEnforcement: No independently verified billing cutoff; trial credit is not a free route.
Restrictions: Temperature is documented as 0.5–1.0. Streaming has not been verified for this route.

Sources.Title: Inception quick start
Sources.Notes: 100M one-time new-account tokens, no payment details; expiry unstated.

Restrictions: The trial is a one-time account grant, not a permanent free tier.
Actual balance, expiry, rate limits and parallelism are unknown without account evidence.
Adding payment details can enable paid continuation; free-only routing is blocked until a verified cutoff exists.
